title: Solar H2 production by a perovskite/silicon tandem cell using urea oxidation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01608D, Communication
Joudi Dabboussi, Vincent Dorcet, Muriel Escadeillas, Corinne Lagrost, Nicolas Penin, Rawa Abdallah, Muriel Matheron, Gabriel Loget
Transition metal-based electrocatalysts are coupled to a perovskite/silicon tandem photovoltaic cell and tested for solar H2 production. UOR significantly boosts H2 evolution performance by allowing operation at the maximum power point.
